fields.statement: Run 01M77DW's land step was refused because change set 01M763Z4's update to ship-check-ci-test-findings' statement rests on a stale base: 01M76B50 (landed via #455) has since rewritten that field. `rhiza check` only warns about an in-flight change set's conflict, so every check passed. land-triage only handles a failed pre-push check, so the run ended with green PR #480 unmerged. How should ship-change handle a land refused on a model conflict?
